runs.text: What problem does a single piece of program that does all the kiosk's work have?
When one piece does everything, every reason to change touches it. Sharing out by information lets each change touch a single piece.
Every change touches it, and nobody understands all of it.

justification.text: A change to the receipt and another to the stock end up in the same place, and to touch it you have to understand all of it.

runs.text: It is slower than several pieces.

justification.text: Speed is not the problem: the problem is changing it without breaking something else.
It runs without trouble; the problem appears when maintaining it.
